title: Let's Learn English Lesson 26
subtitle: This Game Is Fun!
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 26: This Game Is Fun! (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is the Roosevelt Memorial. Where is the symbol?
dialogue.zh: 这是罗斯福纪念堂。那个象征在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yay! I found Uncle Sam and I won another 40 points! What is the Fun Fact?
dialogue.zh: 耶！我找到了山姆大叔，又得了 40 分！趣闻是什么？

dialogue.speaker: Voice
dialogue.en: Franklin Roosevelt was the first to fly in a plane as president!
dialogue.zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福是第一位以总统身份坐飞机的人！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I didn't know that. This is a really beautiful memorial.
dialogue.zh: 我以前不知道。这座纪念堂真漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This is the Lincoln Memorial! Where is the symbol?
dialogue.zh: 这是林肯纪念堂！那个象征在哪里？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I found it! The Statue of Liberty! Please give me my Fun Fact.
dialogue.zh: 找到了！自由女神像！请给我趣闻。

dialogue.speaker: Voice
dialogue.en: Abraham Lincoln was a great wrestler!
dialogue.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯是个很棒的摔跤手！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I didn't know that. Lincoln wanted freedom for all people. So, the Statue of Liberty works well.
dialogue.zh: 我以前不知道。林肯希望所有人都自由。所以自由女神像很合适。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: And I won 20 points! Time to find the next symbol.
dialogue.zh: 我还得了 20 分！该找下一个象征了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Hey! Look out!
dialogue.zh: 嘿！小心！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Hey, it's you! Now, I should be more careful.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。嘿，是你！现在我该更小心了。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: That's okay.
dialogue.zh: 没关系。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: This game is a lot of fun. Hey, what's your name?
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏很好玩。嘿，你叫什么名字？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Dan. What's yours?
dialogue.zh: 丹。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Anna.
dialogue.zh: 安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Like Americana!
dialogue.zh: 就像 Americana！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yeah, I guess so.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，算是吧。

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Did you find any symbols?
dialogue.zh: 你找到象征了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes, I found three and won 120 points!
dialogue.zh: 找到了，我找到三个，得了 120 分！

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Me too. But, did you find the bald eagle?
dialogue.zh: 我也是。不过，你找到白头海雕了吗？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. Did you?
dialogue.zh: 没有。你呢？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: No.
dialogue.zh: 没有。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: First one to find it wins?
dialogue.zh: 谁先找到谁赢？

dialogue.speaker: Dan
dialogue.en: Anna, look out for that tree!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，小心那棵树！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I learned a lot about presidents with this game. But I ought to be more careful. Until next time …!
dialogue.zh: 这个游戏让我学到很多总统的事。不过我应该更小心。下次见……！

quiz.prompt: Where does Anna find Uncle Sam?
What Fun Fact does Anna hear about Abraham Lincoln?
choices: He was the first to fly as president

quiz.prompt: How many points does Anna say she won?
